svg.title: P99 latency
svg.desc: Payment requests land as dots on a response time axis. Most pile up around 60 ms and one in a hundred lands past one second. The average marker sits at a healthy 80 ms, then the p50 and p99 markers slide into place, and the p99 lands at 1.6 seconds, past the merchants' 1 second timeout.
svg.text: The average looks fine. The p99 shows the 1 in 100 that miss the timeout.
